patthana23.48:2.1: na ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassana appaṭigho apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.48:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na nevācayagāmi nāpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho nevācayagāmi nāpacayagāmi dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na sekhaṃ
